description: bbs-foundations hooks. Doctrine: before a subscribed skill runs — whether Claude calls the Skill tool (PreToolUse) or the user types the slash command (UserPromptExpansion) — inject the BBS CLAUDE.md doctrine or the grounding doctrine as context. Subscriptions and text live in hooks/doctrine/; the scripts re-key nothing. Interpreter chosen by the shell Claude Code runs hooks through (Git Bash on Windows, sh on macOS): pwsh 7, else Windows PowerShell 5.1, else python3 (doctrine.py, same logic), else nothing. Fails open: never blocks a skill. Customer folders: when a session starts in, or Claude writes a file in, a folder under SharePoint MASTER/Customers/, remind it to create that customer's CLAUDE.md if none sits between there and the customer root (a write reminds once per customer per session), or, at session start, to keep the nearest one current, outcomes first. Silent in State of CA Agencies (the bbs-sales quote desk keeps buyer-level files) and in DO NOT USE folders. Text lives in hooks/customer-folder/; customer-folder.ps1 and customer-folder.py are the same logic, same interpreter order. Fails open: never blocks a tool.

hooks.command: command -v pwsh >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; command -v powershell >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.ps1"; command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/doctrine.py"; exit 0
